items.title: Self-contained kanban board
items.notes: roadmap-board.html; polls roadmap.json every 2s, light/dark, glows recent items.

items.title: vibemap skill
items.notes: Teaches Claude to keep roadmap.json current during chat.

items.title: One-line installer
items.notes: install.sh copies skill + board to ~/.claude/skills/vibemap/.

items.title: Remote GitHub repo
items.notes: github.com/mmyslin/vibemap (private).

items.title: Scoping docs (global / per-project / disable)
items.notes: README section on skill scoping + skillOverrides.

items.title: Make the repo public
items.notes: gh repo edit --visibility public when ready.

items.title: Add screenshots / GIF to README
items.notes: Show the board beside chat.

items.title: Instant updates (SSE/websocket)
items.notes: Replace 2s polling for zero-lag refresh.

items.title: Edit/reorder cards in the board UI
items.notes: Drag-and-drop; write back to roadmap.json.

items.title: MCP server version
items.notes: Structured roadmap tools; update board outside an active chat session.

items.title: Distribute as a Claude Code plugin
items.notes: Marketplace entry so install is one command.

items.title: Compact UI mode
items.notes: Extremely compact by default: trimmed padding, smaller type, all-caps tracked labels.

items.title: Collapsible swimlanes
items.notes: Fold columns/groups to focus on active work.

items.title: External board/ticketing integrations
items.notes: Two-tier design (NOT a source-of-truth swap): keep roadmap.json as the default local, zero-infra planning surface; add an optional GitHub mode where a card is promoted to a real issue (its #N becomes the issue number) and a gh-driven sync mirrors status via labels and closes issues on Done. The static board can't auth to the GitHub API, so roadmap.json stays as the local view that GitHub syncs into. Also covers Linear/Jira later. Shelved for now.

items.title: Click a card to start implementing
items.notes: Delivered via the card play button: copies a 'start implementing' prompt to paste into Claude. Copy confirmed working in the desktop pane.

items.title: Independently scrollable swimlanes
items.notes: Each lane bounded with its own scroll; page no longer overflows when lanes stack vertically.

items.title: Visual polish: Claude palette + cards
items.notes: De-bolded titles; click-to-expand descriptions (collapsed by default); warm palette matching Claude Code.

items.title: Resizable lanes (drag handles)
items.notes: Drag the border between two lanes to reallocate space; vertical handles side-by-side, horizontal when stacked. Min-size clamp prevents collapse.

items.title: Auto-stack lanes on narrow panes
items.notes: Switches to columns at >=740px, stacks below, reacting live to pane width via ResizeObserver (+ resize/interval fallbacks). Replaces the fixed media-query breakpoint.

items.title: Card hover controls (copy / expand)
items.notes: Reopened: controls' hover lost near the scrollbar (worst on the top items of a scrolling lane, likely overlay-scrollbar thumb). Added reserved gutter + classic scrollbar + inset controls (right 8px) + 0.3s linger so overshoot doesn't drop them. Pending confirmation on the desktop app.

items.title: Project-specific roadmap titles
items.notes: Let the header show a per-project name via an optional 'title' field in roadmap.json, defaulting to 'Roadmap'.

items.title: Card reference numbers (#N)
items.notes: Each card shows a stable #N (never reused), assigned from a top-level seq counter; replaces the 'updated' subtitle (kept as a hover tooltip).

items.title: Resolve #N references in chat
items.notes: Skill resolves '#N' mentions (e.g. 'do #10') to the item whose ref==N and acts on it.

items.title: Add new items from the board (+)
items.notes: A '+' affordance to create new backlog cards directly on the board. Needs board write access — same dependency as inline Edit / move-on-click.

items.title: Analyze backlog dependencies, recommend sequences
items.notes: Analyze backlog items for technical dependencies and generate recommended sequences (build orders) of items.

items.title: UI for recommended sequences
items.notes: Surface the recommended build sequences from #26 on the board (ordering, dependency hints).

items.title: Inline edit cards (pencil)
items.notes: Edit a card's title/notes in place via the pencil button; writes back to roadmap.json (needs board write access — shared with #25 and move-on-click).
